pre_command: open /Users/admin/Desktop; osascript -e 'tell application "Finder" to close windows' && rm -rf /Users/admin/Documents/benchmark_files/ && cp -r /Users/admin/Benchmark_Backup/benchmark_files /Users/admin/Documents && open /Users/admin/Documents/benchmark_files/Multimedia/Faces
instruction: Preview the png image without opening it.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get value of attribute "AXChildren" of window 1 of (first application process whose frontmost is true)' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "000004.png" && osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get value of attribute "AXTitle" of window 1 of (first application process whose frontmost is true)' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Quick Look" && echo "True" || echo "False"
